messages:
marta: Pushed final draft for the Optimize launch blog. Main asks: approve CTA mix, confirm translations (FR/DE/JA), lock HubSpot naming, and confirm partner co-host for webinar promo. Can we quick-pass? :pray:

elaine: Thanks — priority is conversions + downstream attribution. I recommend primary hero CTA -> webinar (low friction), secondary -> gated benchmark PDF. Translation team will localize hero + CTA only for first pass.

samir: For experiments: A/B headline (stat-first vs benefit-first) and CTA color test (green vs blue). Also propose audience split for paid boost: 70% lookalikes to product-engaged, 30% industry list.

nora: Design checks: need final hero stat and translations to render correctly in SVG. Will create localized hero PNGs and a responsive hero chart. Can deliver by EOD tomorrow if copy locks.

josh: HubSpot naming proposal (ops template):
```
Workflow: Launch - Optimize - Blog - Webinar
Trigger: Form submission = Optimize Webinar Form
Action: Add to list: Launch - Optimize - Webinar
Action: Set property: campaign_id = optimize_launch_2026
Action: If company_size > 100 -> Create task: Assign to SDR queue = Product Launch
```
Also create workflow for PDF downloads: Launch - Optimize - Blog - PDF.

lisa: Partner co-host idea: reach out to VectorCloud for a short joint panel. They'll cross-promote if we feature a short benchmark case study. I can ping their AE today.

marta: Great. Also decision needed on UTMs. Samir, can you confirm utm pattern?

samir: Proposed UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026, utm_content={hero_video|cta_webinar|cta_pdf}, utm_term=benchmark. Use explicit utm_content values for social/video variants.

josh: Ops note: add hidden form fields campaign_id=optimize_launch_2026 and source_detail=blog_hero or blog_sidebar to all forms for Segment mapping. Also send server-side event on PDF download to avoid client-side attribution loss.

nora: On translations: FR and DE will be priority; JA if partner co-host confirms JP attendance. We should localize CTA copy and hero line only for speed; rest of post can stay EN with a translation CTA.

elain: (typo) Elaine here — :wave: I approve CTA split. Legal please quick-pass benchmark wording. Maria out today so we need conservative language: "in our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 45% while improving throughput by up to 3x."

marta: OK we'll use that wording. Ops-bot, please add publish checklist and timeline.

ops-bot: Publish checklist created:
- copy locked (marta)
- legal-approved hero language (placeholder, conservative phrasing)
- hero images + localized PNGs (nora)
- gated PDF uploaded to CDN (nora)
- HubSpot workflows staged (josh)
- UTMs confirmed (samir)
- partner outreach (lisa)
- schedule: blog publish -> partner email (day 1) -> paid boost (day 2) -> webinar reminder (day 5)

marta: Drafting outreach email for VectorCloud and partner assets now. If everyone signs off I'll schedule publish for Tue 09:00 PT and unpause workflows then. Anyone object?

samir: No objections. I'll prepare social copy variants and the paid boost target list.

josh: I'll run end-to-end form tests on staging once assets are uploaded and unpause at publish time.

nora: Uploading hero variants and localized PNGs to /cdn/marketing/optimize-launch/ in 3 hours.

marta: Thanks all — locking draft for final asset sync. :rocket:
